_comment: Shared thresholds for check_complexity.py (Claude Code PostToolUse hook) and the reduce-cyclomatic-complexity skill. Keep this the single source of truth so the agent-time hook, the skill, and CI all judge code by the same bar.
_mode_comment: 'warn' = report findings, exit 0, never block. 'block' = exit 2 on any violation so Claude Code must fix it before continuing. Recommended: run 'warn' for one sprint to tune thresholds/excludes against real false-positive rate, then flip to 'block'.
